items.markdown:
Skincare clinical trials `evaluate the safety, tolerance, and effectiveness of new topical treatments, devices, and cosmetic formulations on human subjects`.[[1]](https://denovaresearch.com/skin-care-clinical-trials/)[[2]](https://essextesting.com/blog/safety-of-skincare-products-in-clinical-trials-and-the-science-behind-safer-beauty/)

### How Skincare Trials Work

- **Ingredient Review:** Formulations undergo initial safety pre-screening and concentration checks.
- **Patch Testing:** Small amounts of a product are applied under controlled conditions to check for early irritation or allergic reactions.
- **Supervised Testing:** IRB-approved studies use human panelists or patients, featuring expert grading, standardized photography, and biophysical measurements (like hydration or barrier function) over 8 to 12 weeks.[[1]](https://www.citruslabs.com/skincare)[[2]](https://essextesting.com/blog/safety-of-skincare-products-in-clinical-trials-and-the-science-behind-safer-beauty/)[[3]](https://denovaresearch.com/skin-care-clinical-trials/)

### Types of Studies

- **Cosmetic & Aesthetic:** Tests anti-aging creams, lasers, fillers, and brightening agents for texture, wrinkles, and tone.
- **Medical Dermatology:** Treats diagnosed conditions like acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, and hair loss under board-certified dermatologists.[[1]](https://www.skincareresearch.org/study-participants/)[[2]](https://www.citruslabs.com/skincare)[[3]](https://www.unionderm.com/current-studies-and-clinical-trials/)[[4]](https://www.centerwatch.com/clinical-trials/listings/therapeutic-area/3/dermatology)

### Finding and Joining Trials

- **Participant Benefits:** Trials often provide study-related care at no cost and compensation for your time and travel.
- **Where to Look:** You can find open enrollment opportunities and volunteer requirements through groups like [Skin Care Research](https://www.skincareresearch.org/study-participants/) or platforms specialized in [Citruslabs Skincare Studies](https://www.citruslabs.com/skincare) . You can also browse active medical listings via [CenterWatch Dermatology Listings](https://www.centerwatch.com/clinical-trials/listings/therapeutic-area/3/dermatology).[[1]](https://www.skincareresearch.org/study-participants/)[[2]](https://www.discc.com/clinical-research/)[[3]](https://www.citruslabs.com/skincare)[[4]](https://www.centerwatch.com/clinical-trials/listings/therapeutic-area/3/dermatology)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Are you looking for a **cosmetic study** (anti-aging, hydration) or a **medical treatment trial** (acne, eczema, psoriasis)?
- What is your **general location** or city?

I can help you find relevant trial categories or local research centers.
